sources.label: Patches for use with Morphe by 0x11DFE
sources.author: 0x11DFE
patch_list: Keeps the scene-daemon monitor gate open so live stats (dashboard cards, overlays) keep updating instead of freezing ~40s after connect. The daemon launcher script re-asserts the gate on every start and fails safe on unknown daemon layouts…

Replaces the device SN with a random value everywhere the app uses it: user page, cloud sync and API calls to omarea. Baked per patch run. The daemon's own activation report is native and not affected.

Shows the gated Optional features entries: Refresh rate, FAS in games and CPU limiters. The gates are cloud-profile and display-API checks, not device limits, so the features work locally. Bypass power supply stays hidden without a support…

Unlocks Scene N1 with a perpetual license and a configurable expiry date. The signature MD5 reported to omarea is spoofed to the original signing key, so re-signed builds still pass the activation binding.
